question: A regular hexagon is inscribed within a circular boundary having a radius of 42 cm. Find the approximate area of this hexagon.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circle = 42 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of a regular hexagon = (3√3 / 2) × (side length)²

Side length of the hexagon = Radius of the circle

**Calculation:**

⇒ Side length = Radius = 42 cm

⇒ Area of the hexagon = (3√3 / 2) × (42)²

⇒ Area = (3√3 / 2) × 1764

⇒ Area = 3√3 × 882

⇒ Area = 3 × 1.732 × 882

⇒ Area ≈ 4583 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4583 cm².**
